releases.body:
### Subtitles fixes and general QOL

- Fixed game language setting effect on subtitles being late by one language
- _Subtle subtitles_ fixes
- Code cleaned

releases.name: Version 1.7.0
releases.body:
### Localization support and fixes
- Added **full french translation and support for more** _(soon, very soon)_
- Added anti-platforming fix _(stop doing that! now it should be near impossible)_
- Cleaned the anti-ship fix _(no more invisible colliders!)_
- Fixed some errors in dialogues
- Fixed a bug with profile game saves
- Fixed a bug with some subtitles not showing
- Fixed speedrun timer being wrong after dying
releases.bodyZh:
### 本地化支持与修复
- 添加了**完整的法语翻译和支持** _(很快，非常快)_
- 添加了反平台机制修复 _(停止那样做！现在应该几乎不可能了)_
- 清理了反飞船修复 _(不再有不可见的碰撞器!)_
- 修复了对话中的一些错误
- 修复了个人资料游戏存档的bug
- 修复了某些字幕不显示的bug
- 修复了死亡后速通计时器错误

releases.name: Version 1.6.0
releases.body:
### Bunch of fixes and improvements!
- The mod now handle multiple player profiles (each one has its own saves)
- Fixed shiplogs _(again!)_, they are clearer and everything useful should stay while relevant
- "Changing audio source" will not weirdly cut the previous dialogue anymore
- Subtitles are less buggy and more reactive (hiding and coming back when they should)
- Speedrun timer's format improved
- Added some acknowledgments to the Readme <3

releases.name: Version 1.5.2
releases.body:
- Added a "Difficulty" setting for all the nostalgics of the days before subtitles _(nobody)_.
- Added a speedrun timer in the settings _because why not_.

releases.name: Version 1.5.0
releases.body:
### - Added **subtitles**!
\- Made shiplog not useless (it stores things you should've heard _but you didn't because you were so bored_).
  
That makes the mod **waay** easier to complete. _(ppl having completed it before this patch will get a golf ball plushie ~~except that's not true~~)_
